reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own message in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it. I also told her there's no later message in that channel saying it was fixed, so she may want to check with Hollis before marking it resolved.

I couldn't find anything that gives Pine Crossing a more specific site, like an address or a different site name. The Jun 9 onboarding ticket (SUP-5102) lists six new stores, and Pine Crossing isn't one of them. The search tool was running on keyword matching only, so it could have missed something worded differently. I only used #central-team, where Pree is a member. I didn't share any finance figures and didn't need approval for anything.
